name: FreshBooks
description: FreshBooks is cloud accounting and invoicing software built for freelancers, self-employed professionals, and small service businesses, featuring client invoicing, expense tracking, time tracking, project profitability, and double-entry accounting reports.
best_for: Freelancers, consultants, agencies, and service-based small businesses that prioritize client invoicing, time tracking, and professional estimates over complex inventory management.
features: Customizable client invoicing with automated payment reminders
Online payment acceptance via credit card, ACH, PayPal, and Stripe
Expense tracking with bank feeds and automated receipt scanning
Built-in time tracking with billable hours converted directly to invoices
Project profitability tracking and team timesheet management
Double-entry accounting reports including Balance Sheet, General Ledger, and Trial Balance
Client estimate creation with one-click conversion to active invoices
Mileage tracking via mobile iOS and Android applications

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.notes: Send unlimited invoices to up to 5 billable clients; track expenses and tax reports.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Up to 50 billable clients; adds automated recurring invoices, client retainers, and double-entry reports.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Unlimited billable clients; adds project profitability tracking, customize email templates, and accounts payable.

tiers.name: Select
tiers.notes: Dedicated account manager, customized migration, and lower credit card transaction fees.

pros: Exceptionally user-friendly invoicing and client payment workflow
Built-in time tracking and project profitability tools included in core platform
Client portal allowing customers to view, accept estimates, and pay invoices directly
cons: Lower tiers enforce strict limits on billable client counts (5 on Lite, 50 on Plus)
Each additional team member seat costs an extra $11/month
Inventory tracking and advanced supply-chain features are less comprehensive than QuickBooks Online

faq.question: Is FreshBooks true double-entry accounting software?
faq.answer: Yes — FreshBooks provides complete double-entry accounting features including General Ledger, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, and Chart of Accounts, making it suitable for year-end tax filing and CPA collaboration.

faq.question: How does FreshBooks pricing compare to QuickBooks Online?
faq.answer: FreshBooks entry pricing ($19/mo on Lite) is lower than QuickBooks Online Simple Start ($38/mo), but FreshBooks caps the number of active billable clients on Lite (5) and Plus (50), whereas QuickBooks does not cap client counts.

alternatives.name: QuickBooks Online
alternatives.description: Intuit cloud accounting platform with deep CPA ecosystem support and advanced inventory capabilities.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses needing uncapped client volume and wide accountant familiarity

alternatives.name: Xero
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting software designed with unlimited users on every tier and strong bank reconciliation UX.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses collaborating with multiple team members without per-seat fees

alternatives.name: Wave
alternatives.description: Free cloud accounting and invoicing software tailored for solopreneurs and freelancers.
alternatives.best_for: Freelancers wanting zero-subscription invoicing and basic double-entry bookkeeping

alternatives.name: Zoho Books
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting software that automates core financial workflows, handles multi-currency invoicing, manages inventory, and integrates with the wider Zoho ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses and existing Zoho users wanting workflow automation and cost-effective multi-user accounting
